name: Duga

facts.text: Duga: level 42, faction Unseelie Court (the only named spawn in the mine with a faction), a goblin body (model 246) like the unseelie mangos who share his faction, at about 29,500/29,800 in the upper workings, under 900 from Frit; respawn 180 seconds; a plain spawn.
Living Server lore: Duga's ledger as the tally of the debts from the broken bargain of the Cursed Forest.

story:
Duga keeps the ledger. The collar found in the upper workings says so, scratched small on the inside: he wrote the groom from Mag Mell into it without asking his name, because he does not want names, he wants hands. He is a goblin of the court, one of the kind the captives call the mangos, and he is the only one of the court's servants in the mine who wears its colours openly, as if he wanted to be seen wearing them.

The Howth miners say the ledger is older than the court's mine. When the bargain broke in the Cursed Forest and the two courts shared out what was left, every debt owed to the Unseelie was written down, and the book they were written in went with the court's clerks wherever there was collecting to be done. The mine, Howth says, is only the page the ledger has reached. Every hand Duga writes down is a debt being paid by someone who never owed it, and the debt does not get smaller.

He keeps his place in the upper workings, among the sentries and the drudging dead, a short walk from the side passage where Frit sits and will not work. He is the one officer who looks at her. He looks at her every day, the captives say, with his pen ready, and writes nothing down.
legend: Duga (42) is in the upper workings of Coruscating Mine (about 29.5k/29.8k) with silvermine sentries (36-43), undead drudgers (36), gemclickers and unseelie underviewers (42) close round him. He is the one named here with a faction (Unseelie Court, same as the unseelie mangos), so clear the court's goblins near him first. Underviewer Treeal is about 1,000 away; Frit (peaceful) under 900: leave her be. Group of low 40s. Plain spawn, 3-minute respawn.
